ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite and drone imagery monitoring platform for university campus land compliance, automated infrastructure expansion tracking, and safety hazard detection.
ideas.title: AkalCampus Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning GeoNex-ATLAS pattern by applying spatial AI to real-world regional infrastructure problems that academic and municipal judges care about.

ideas.pitch: Graph-intelligence and LightGBM-powered agricultural loan risk assessment platform tailored for local farming cooperatives and rural banking institutions in Punjab.
ideas.title: AgriRisk Intel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the Bito pattern of combining graph intelligence and explainable machine learning to solve a hyper-relevant financial and agricultural problem for regional judges.

ideas.pitch: Personalized AI nutrition assistant optimized for traditional North Indian diets, regional crop availability, and local health metrics.
ideas.title: BioNutri Local
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the E-Foodiee winning approach but tailors the domain specifically to local dietary habits, ensuring high practical relevance during judging.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent student support and campus sustainability platform combining RAG and LangGraph to track energy usage and automate resource conservation initiatives.
ideas.title: EcoCampus AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emulates the greennovation-ai-platform winning structure by deploying a multi-agent RAG workflow targeting institutional operational efficiency.

ideas.pitch: Poisson regression and GAM-based predictive forecasting model for local public safety and municipal incident reporting in Talwandi Sabo region.
ideas.title: IncidentCast Punjab
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous statistical modeling seen in the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon winner rather than relying on generic wrapper tools.
